treatment efficacy.","kind":"study_method","source_unit_ids":["E21.U1"],"qualitative_finding":"A large single-cell study characterized immune responses in bacterial pneumonia and highlighted potential therapeutic targets without assessing antibiotic treatment efficacy.","source_quantity_ids":["E21.U1.Q1","E21.U1.Q3","E21.U1.Q4"],"numeric_dependency":true},{"statement_id":"S3","text":"A review of hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated pneumonia due to specific Gram-negative pathogens.","kind":"study_finding","source_unit_ids":["E41.U1"],"qualitative_finding":"New β-lactam/β-lactamase inhibitor combination antibiotics are indicated for treating several infections including hospital-acquired and ventilator-associated pneumonia caused by specific Gram-negative bacteria.","source_quantity_ids":[],"numeric_dependency":false}],"conclusion":"The supplied sources address antibiotic use in bacterial pneumonia indirectly: one meta-analysis questions None directly tests whether antibiotics can treat bacterial pneumonia as a general causal claim.","uncertainty_reasons":["No source directly evaluates the general causal assertion that antibiotics can treat bacterial pneumonia.","The meta-analysis focuses on procalcitonin's diagnostic performance rather than antibiotic efficacy.","The single-cell study and review describe disease biology and drug indications, not comparative treatment outcomes."]}]}
